cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Renewables & Solar lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +5.31%; weakest is Renewables & Solar at -0.71%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.body: Leaders: BE +11.89%, VRT +8.30%, OKLO +6.77%, VST +5.33%, FLNC +4.61%. Laggards: MPLX -2.56%, EQNR -1.62%, NEE -1.29%, EOG -1.01%.
